subject.title: message tool should auto-select the only enabled account

question: Should omitted message-tool account IDs infer a single enabled configured account after explicit/default/bound precedence, or should OpenClaw continue requiring explicit accountId/defaultAccount when the configured default is disabled?
rationale: The code boundary is clear, but the behavior changes fallback semantics for existing multi-account setups and can change whether sends auto-select an account or fail closed.

options.title: Accept shared resolver policy
options.body: Land or replace the linked PR with a shared resolver that selects an enabled configured default or exactly one enabled configured account after explicit/default/bound precedence.

options.title: Keep explicit account selection
options.body: Keep current semantics and document that users must set accountId or defaultAccount when a multi-account channel's default account is disabled.

options.title: Require channel-owned fallback
options.body: Ask for channel-owned behavior if maintainers do not want core to own this fallback policy across message channels.

recommendation.title: Accept shared resolver policy
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked PR with a shared resolver that selects an enabled configured default or exactly one enabled configured account after explicit/default/bound precedence.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already supplied the prior shared-resolver direction and is the strongest routing candidate for the fallback policy decision.
